       74 +    use super::*;                                                              
       75 +                                                                               
       76 +    fn parse(args: &[&str]) -> Result<Parsed, String> {                        
       77 +        parse_args(args.iter().map(|s| s.to_string()))                         
       78 +    }                                                                          
       79 +                                                                               
       80 +    #[test]                                                                    
       81 +    fn defaults_turn_mouse_and_paste_on() {                                    
       82 +        let want = Opts { mouse: true, paste: true, ..Opts::default() };       
       83 +        assert_eq!(parse(&[]), Ok(Parsed::Run(want)));                         
       84 +    }                                                                          
       85 +                                                                               
       86 +    #[test]                                                                    
       87 +    fn every_flag_is_recognised() {                                            
       88 +        let got = parse(&["--no-mouse", "--no-paste", "--kitty-query", "--app-c
          +ursor", "--exit-after", "1500"]);                                              
       89 +        let want = Opts {                                                      
       90 +            mouse: false,                                                      
       91 +            paste: false,                                                      
       92 +            kitty_query: true,                                                 
       93 +            app_cursor: true,                                                  
       94 +            exit_after: Some(Duration::from_millis(1500)),                     
       95 +        };                                                                     
       96 +        assert_eq!(got, Ok(Parsed::Run(want)));                                
       97 +    }                                                                          
       98 +                                                                               
       99 +    #[test]                                                                    
      100 +    fn bad_arguments_are_errors() {                                            
      101 +        assert!(parse(&["--exit-after"]).is_err());                            
      102 +        assert!(parse(&["--exit-after", "soon"]).is_err());                    
      103 +        assert!(parse(&["--bogus"]).is_err());                                 
      104 +        assert_eq!(parse(&["--help"]), Ok(Parsed::Help));                      
      105 +    }
